text: Entry Requirements 1.Applicants should generally be 18–30 years old, meet the requirements of the Nationality Law of the People’s Republic of China, and be non-Chinese citizens holding a valid ordinary foreign passport. (1) According to Article 5 of the Nationality Law of the People’s Republic of China, individuals who were born abroad and acquired foreign nationality at birth, with one or both parents being Chinese citizens who have settled abroad, do not hold Chinese nationality. Since 2021, such applicants applying as international students for undergraduate studies must, in addition to meeting other admission requirements, hold a valid foreign passport or nationality certificate for at least four (4) years, and must have resided abroad for at least two (2) years within the most recent four years (up to April 30 of the year of enrollment). Residence abroad of 9 months within a year may be counted as one full year, subject to entry and exit stamps. (2) Residents of Mainland China, Hong Kong, Macao, or Taiwan who have emigrated and acquired foreign nationality and apply as international students must also meet the requirements stated in (1). For details, please refer to the Ministry of Education document Notice on Regulating the Acceptance of International Students by Higher Education Institutions (Jiao Wai Han [2020] No. 12) 2.Applicants must have completed high school or possess an equivalent academic qualification, with academic performance (including Physics, Chemistry, and Biology) meeting admission requirements. Applicants with excellent results in the university’s foundation program will be given priority. 3.Applicants must be in good physical health and meet the specific admission requirements of the applied major: No severe myopia, color blindness, or color weakness; Normal hearing, sense of smell, and speech ability; Applicants with infectious diseases (such as hepatitis B, HIV, syphilis, tuberculosis), serious chronic illnesses, or other conditions that may affect completion of studies may apply only after full recovery; Applicants with mental or psychological disorders are not recommended to apply. Applicants found unfit for study during the entrance medical examination will have their admission cancelled. Health requirements are implemented in accordance with the Guiding Opinions on Physical Examination for Enrollment in Ordinary Higher Education Institutions (Teaching [2003] No. 3) and relevant supplementary regulations: 4.Applicants must abide by the laws and regulations of the People’s Republic of China and the rules of Wenzhou Medical University. *Note: The Dental Surgery (BDS) program does not accept left-handed applicants. 5.CSCA (Undergraduate Academic Proficiency Test for Studying in China) transcript, with test subjects including English Mathematics and English Chemistry 6.Proof of English proficiency (IELTS, TOEFL, Duolingo, or other recognized tests: IELTS ≥ 6.0 with no band below 5.0; TOEFL ≥ 70 with no section below 15; Duolingo ≥ 105), or Proof of full high-school education conducted in English.
